title: Testing delayed-refresh optimistic UI in inboxReportDetailLogic tests
answers: How to test optimistic state during a slow loader in kea logic
Test reviewer update failure restores list
body:
In products/signals/frontend/inbox/logics/inboxReportDetailLogic.test.ts ('reviewer updates'): mount the logic with useMocks for artefacts/signals/available_reviewers GET and reviewers PUT.
To hold a refresh, re-call useMocks with an async GET handler for '/api/projects/:team_id/signals/reports/:id/artefacts/' that awaits a manually resolved promise; `waitFor` the handler to start, assert `displayReviewers` and `isUpdatingReviewers` mid-flight, then release in `finally` and `await expectLogic(logic).toFinishAllListeners()`.
Failure case: mock the PUT as `[500, { detail: ... }]` and assert `displayReviewers` returns to the original and `isUpdatingReviewers` is false.
applies: Logic tests for kea optimistic updates in signals inbox
